text:
Here’s my take on Sonic as a 3D voxel model!
Like my other models, I wanted to keep this focused on capturing the look of Sonic’s classic game sprite as a 3D voxel model.
It was a fun one to put together, and I’m really happy with how he turned out.
What do you think of this one? 😄
